spec.problem: Verify current learner Search History route and its visible history/clear interactions at desktop/mobile with the authenticated browser session.

acceptance.text: Open /vi/search/history in the visible browser and verify authenticated rendering, history items, navigation back to Search, individual removal and clear-all behavior without changing non-test learner data.
Verify anonymous access behavior and mobile 390x844 layout without horizontal overflow.
At 390x844 every history row's remove button is visible and has a usable touch target; clicking removes only that item and persists across route change/refresh.

spec.expected_behavior: Each history row exposes a clearly visible, touch-sized remove button on mobile while desktop can retain hover refinement; individual deletion and clear-all still work.
spec.observed_behavior: At the visible 390x844 viewport the Search History screen lists history items but each individual remove button uses opacity-0 and is effectively invisible until hover; no hover exists on touch.
spec.rollback_plan: Revert the Search History row remove-button visibility and touch-target changes plus its test.

classification.rationale: Visible mobile audit found that individual history deletion is inaccessible on touch because the button is opacity-0 by default.

red_targets.test: SearchHistoryClient > keeps each individual remove control visible and touch-sized on mobile
